faqs.q: What happens after I apply for an Owner-Builder Permit?
faqs.a: Your application will be assessed by Building Commission NSW on set criteria. If Building Commission NSW contacts you for more information, the processing time may increase. You will be notified about the result when the assessment is completed.

faqs.q: How can I apply for an Owner-Builder Permit?
faqs.a: You can apply online by logging into or creating a MyServiceNSW Account, or you can apply in person by booking an appointment at a service centre.

faqs.q: What documents do I need to apply?
faqs.a: You need a MyServiceNSW Account, proof of identity, a current general construction induction card, evidence of owner-builder approved education requirements, documentation including proof of ownership, details, and signatures of all owners, development approval or a complying development certificate, the special circumstances additional details form (if relevant), and your payment.
